text:
جیٹھ جیٹھا، ہاڑ پچھیا،
ساون وی جواری جیہا۔
romanized:
Jéth jétha, Har pichhéea,
Sawan vi jawari jeha.
literal_en: Sown in Jeth (May-June) it is best of all, in Har (June-July), it is late, even in Sawan it is as good as jawar.

source.book: Grammar and Dictionary of Western Panjabi, as spoken in the Shahpur District, with Proverbs, Sayings and Verses
